subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and custom theme studio with a broader persistence contract?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower external-editor import model, while this issue requests a larger in-product authoring, preset, and persistence surface that needs product/design ownership.

options.title: Define a native theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Treat the existing tweakcn import slot as the supported customization path and narrow or close the larger in-product studio request after documenting that direction.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Break the request into product-approved slices such as interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing.

recommendation.title: Define a native theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the issue and authored the current tweakcn import/theming path, making them the best available routing owner for the product choice.
